title: Check: History of the Periodic Table (B)

questions.stem: How is the modern periodic table arranged differently from Mendeleev's original version?

options.text: By atomic mass instead of atomic number
By atomic number (proton number) instead of atomic mass
By the year each element was discovered

questions.explanation: The modern periodic table is arranged by atomic number (proton number), following the work of Henry Moseley in 1913. Mendeleev arranged his table by atomic mass, which caused problems like argon (mass 40) and potassium (mass 39) being in the wrong order.
